blocks.text: 2 Chronicles 19 contains 11 verses. It opens with: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem. It concludes with: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of Jehovah; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and Jehovah be with the good.
